a: Even if this card's [Main] effect doesn't suspend your Digimon, 1 Digimon unsuspends.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect even if the "if" condition in the 2nd process isn't met?

Effect: [Main] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, unsuspend 1 Digimon.
Security Effect: [Security] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
